Tests block-device vinyl I/O init, accessors, scratch pad, resume, and invalid store cases.

# Purpose
This file is a C test program for `fd_vinyl_io_bd`, the block-device backed `fd_vinyl` I/O layer. It creates a test storage file, initializes the I/O object, checks accessors and scratch-pad allocation behavior, and then verifies abort and resume paths with the same backing store. The code also tests invalid store sizes, non-seekable file descriptors, and other error cases to confirm that `fd_vinyl_io_bd_init` rejects bad input. At the end, it removes the temporary file, releases the random number generator, and halts the `fd` runtime after a passing test run.
